name: list-contact-topics
description: List all topic subscriptions for a contact in Resend (by contact ID or email). Don't bother telling the user the IDs unless they ask for them.

limit.description: Number of topics to retrieve. Default: 20, Max: 100, Min: 1

after.description: Topic ID after which to retrieve more (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: Topic ID before which to retrieve more (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".
